Pika! }} '''Pikachu Land''' (Japanese: '''ピカチュウランド''' ''Pikachu Land'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the [[Kalos]] [[region]]. It is a film set found in between [[Laverre City]] and [[Dendemille Town]]. It is owned by [[Frank]], a movie director, and the location for his movie, ''{{DL|Movies in the Pokémon world|Lightning Fast! Brave and Strong! Super-Pikachu!}}''. In ''[[XY078|Lights! Camera! Pika!]]'', {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} passed Pikachu Land on their way to Dendemille Town. They noticed a large group of {{p|Pikachu}} dancing there and decided to check it out. There they met Frank and his granddaughter [[Jean]], and decided to assist Frank in filming his movie called ''Lightning Fast! Brave and Strong! Super-Pikachu!''. In the movie, Pikachu Land is a peaceful town inhabited only by Pikachu. ==In other languages== {{langtable|color={{x color}}|bordercolor={{y color dark}}|textcolor=fff |it=Pikachulandia |ko=피카츄 랜드 ''Pikachu Land'' |pl=Pikachu Land |ru=Земля Пикачу ''Zemlya Pikachu'' }} {{-}} {{Kalosanime}} {{DoubleProjectTag|Anime|Locations|locations in the animated series.}} [[it:Pikachulandia]] [[zh:皮卡丘园地]]
